0022600025.text: Washington (4-4, 8th in the East, 2nd in the Southeast and half a game back) visits Atlanta (5-4, 1st in the Southeast, 4th in the East, and riding a two-game win streak) in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group C matchup, the Wizards' ninth game of the season. The Wizards are currently without Anthony Davis (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve), while the Hawks are without Asa Newell (toe), Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Keshon Gilbert (knee inflammation), and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). Washington trails the season series 0-1 after losing 120-105 in Washington earlier this season, and it also lost the 2025-26 series 1-3.
